summary: Yeysk Airport (EIK) is a medium-sized regional airport serving the city of Yeysk in Krasnodar Krai, Russia, located on the coast of the Sea of Azov. It primarily handles domestic flights and serves as a gateway to this popular Black Sea and Azov Sea resort destination. The airport has historical significance dating back to the Soviet era when it supported both civilian and military aviation activities in the region.
faqs:
Q: What is the main purpose of Yeysk Airport?
A: The airport primarily serves the resort city of Yeysk on the Sea of Azov, handling domestic passenger flights and seasonal charter operations.

Q: Does Yeysk Airport offer international flights?
A: The airport mainly operates domestic routes within Russia, with occasional seasonal charter services.

Q: How far is the airport from Yeysk city center?
A: The airport is located a short drive from central Yeysk, making it convenient for travelers heading to the coastal resort areas.

Q: Are there nearby alternative airports?
A: Yes, Rostov-on-Don Airport and Krasnodar International Airport are larger alternatives within reasonable traveling distance.
transport_tips: Taxis and private transfers are the most reliable way to reach Yeysk city center from the airport, typically taking around 15-20 minutes. Public transport options are limited, so arranging a transfer in advance is recommended during peak summer season. Rental car services can also be arranged for travelers wishing to explore the Krasnodar Krai region independently.
local_tip: Visit Yeysk's famous sand spit (Yeysk Spit) at sunset — it stretches into the Sea of Azov and offers some of the best views in the region, just a short drive from the airport.
